newsitem.title: USA: Sherwin-Williams closes Thompson Minwax purchase.
newsitem.headline: Sherwin-Williams closes Thompson Minwax purchase.

text.p: Sherwin-Williams Co on Wednesday said it completed its purchase of all of the shares of Thompson Minwax Holding Corp for $830 million in cash.
Sherwin-Williams in November reached a definitive agreement with Forstmann Little & Co and other partners to buy the company, which produces interior stains and varishes, among other products.
To finance the purchase, Sherwin-Williams issued commercial paper supported by a new bank credit agreement.
Sherwin-Williams produces paints, varnishes and related products and operates stores for contractors and the do-it-yourself market.
